  <rect x="48" y="228" width="294" height="74" rx="16" fill="#101317" opacity="0.95" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.08"/>
  <text x="64" y="252" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Lexend" font-size="14" font-weight="700">1. Acceptance of Terms</text>
  <text x="64" y="271" fill="#DADADA" font-family="Lexend" font-size="11" font-weight="300">By creating an account or booking a service,</text>
  <text x="64" y="285" fill="#DADADA" font-family="Lexend" font-size="11" font-weight="300">you agree to these conditions and app policies.</text>

  <rect x="48" y="314" width="294" height="90" rx="16" fill="#101317" opacity="0.95" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.08"/>
  <text x="64" y="338" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Lexend" font-size="14" font-weight="700">2. Bookings & Payments</text>
  <text x="64" y="357" fill="#DADADA" font-family="Lexend" font-size="11" font-weight="300">Service estimates, taxes, and fees are shown</text>
  <text x="64" y="371" fill="#DADADA" font-family="Lexend" font-size="11" font-weight="300">before checkout. Cancellations may incur charges.</text>
  <text x="64" y="385" fill="#DADADA" font-family="Lexend" font-size="11" font-weight="300">Refunds are processed according to provider rules.</text>

  <rect x="48" y="416" width="294" height="90" rx="16" fill="#101317" opacity="0.95" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.08"/>
  <text x="64" y="440" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Lexend" font-size="14" font-weight="700">3. User Responsibilities</text>
  <text x="64" y="459" fill="#DADADA" font-family="Lexend" font-size="11" font-weight="300">Keep your profile details accurate and verify</text>
  <text x="64" y="473" fill="#DADADA" font-family="Lexend" font-size="11" font-weight="300">access to your phone number and payment method.</text>
  <text x="64" y="487" fill="#DADADA" font-family="Lexend" font-size="11" font-weight="300">Do not misuse the platform or bypass bookings.</text>

  <rect x="48" y="518" width="294" height="104" rx="16" fill="#101317" opacity="0.95" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.08"/>
  <text x="64" y="542" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Lexend" font-size="14" font-weight="700">4. Privacy & Data</text>
  <text x="64" y="561" fill="#DADADA" font-family="Lexend" font-size="11" font-weight="300">We use your location and contact information to</text>
  <text x="64" y="575" fill="#DADADA" font-family="Lexend" font-size="11" font-weight="300">connect you with nearby professionals and send</text>
  <text x="64" y="589" fill="#DADADA" font-family="Lexend" font-size="11" font-weight="300">booking updates, reminders, and support messages.</text>
  <text x="64" y="603" fill="#DADADA" font-family="Lexend" font-size="11" font-weight="300">Your data is handled per the privacy policy.</text>
